text: Identify the option that correctly changes the given active sentence to passive voice: 'The chef prepared a delicious six-course meal for the guests.'

options.text: A delicious six-course meal is prepared for the guests by the chef.
A delicious six-course meal was prepared for the guests by the chef.
A delicious six-course meal has been prepared for the guests by the chef.
A delicious six-course meal was being prepared for the guests by the chef.

explanation: Simple past changes to 'was/were + past participle (prepared)'. Option 2 is correct.

text: Which of the following sentences contain grammatical errors? (Select all correct options)

options.text: Each of the students have completed their assignment.
Neither the teacher nor the students were satisfied with the decision.
Between you and I, this project is bound to succeed.
The team is playing its best game of the season.

explanation: Option 1 has subject-verb agreement error ('Each... has completed'). Option 3 has pronoun case error after preposition ('Between you and me').

text: Complete the sentence with the correct prepositions: 'The executive committee agreed ___ the proposals ___ its meeting yesterday.'
explanation: One agrees 'to' proposals, and meetings happen 'at' a place/time. So, 'to, at' is correct.
